newsitem.title: USA: Halter Marine plans debt offering.
newsitem.headline: Halter Marine plans debt offering.

text.p: Halter Marine Group Inc said Thursday it is preparing a Rule 144A offering of debt securities and the offer would involve $100 million of debt securities, although the size and terms could change.

Halter said it would use proceeds to repay indebtedness under its senior credit facility and to repay the principal amount of promissory notes issued in connection with the acquisition of Texas Drydock Inc.
It said it would complete the offer by mid September.
